_smx1_text_drawing_basis: smx1i (javap -c -p of both code jars): 1.21.11 draws widget and label text through an ActiveTextCollector (class_12225). MultiLineLabel.Align (class_5489$class_11735) is top-level class_11735: same constants, constructors and method_73214 bodies ($1..$3 too); 1.21.11 only widens method_73214 to public and adds method_75792. MultiLineLabel.render / getStyle (method_73212 / method_72103) are 1.21.10's bodies over the lines visitLines (method_75816) hands a collector, with the label's own font (rt/CbTextDrawing; the never-read shadow argument is dropped as 1.21.10 dropped it). AbstractWidget.renderScrollingString and its statics, AbstractButton.renderString and the SpriteIconButton renderString overrides come back with 1.21.10's bodies over GuiGraphics' scissor / drawString, which 1.21.11 keeps. A 1.21.10 button overriding renderString is reached from 1.21.11's renderDefaultLabel (method_75793) with 1.21.10's arguments (the collector's GuiGraphics, the client font, ARGB.color(alpha, active ? white : 0xFFA0A0A0)); a 1.21.10 SpriteIconButton subclass from renderContents (its text was never a default label). renderContents (method_75752) is abstract in 1.21.11; a 1.21.10 button class gets AbstractButton's 1.21.10 drawing: the sprite, then the label through the GuiGraphics' collector, as 1.21.11's Button.Plain. StringSplitter.componentStyleAtWidth (method_30876, which 1.21.10's getStyle used) comes back on StringSplitter with 1.21.10's body (mixin/CbStringSplitterRestoredMixin).

overrideHooks.basis: 1.21.10's AbstractButton.renderWidget called this.renderString(graphics, client font, ARGB.color(alpha, active ? -1 : 0xFFA0A0A0)); 1.21.11's renderContents draws the text through renderDefaultLabel(collector), whose GuiGraphics collector carries the graphics
1.21.10's AbstractButton.renderString called this.renderScrollingString(graphics, font, 2, color); 1.21.11's renderDefaultLabel calls renderScrollingLabel(collector, getMessage(), 2)

1.21.10's SpriteIconButton subclasses drew AbstractButton's sprite, this.renderString and then the icon (centred, or right less 2 for TextAndIcon); 1.21.11's CenteredIcon / TextAndIcon renderContents draw their own text and never reach renderDefaultLabel

abstractFills.basis: renderContents is new and abstract in 1.21.11 (absent from 1.21.10's class_4264, javap both); a 1.21.10 button class drew what AbstractButton.renderWidget drew: the default sprite, then the text
